author: More Perfect Union
description:
Farmers are getting slammed by the war on Iran.

The price of diesel is through the roof, the cost of fertilizer skyrocketed, and farm bankruptcies are up 46%.

70% of farmers now say they can't afford to fertilize their fields this season. Trump has caused a farm crisis.

Producer: wadrewhawkins
Editor: niklaak
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
Videographer: Jay Marcano
title: Farmers turn on Trump: “It’s gonna be the nail in the coffin.”
